cases.name: lf-unicode-download-roundtrip
cases.expected: Native UI-authored unfinished LF and Unicode strings survive actual download, fresh load, preview and explicit apply; draft stage has zero events.

cases.name: external-lineendings-reject-or-preserve
cases.expected: External draft with CR/LF in single-line fields or CR in textarea fields is either refused before changing current work or retains every literal admitted value on apply and re-download.

cases.name: edit-before-file-choice-preserved
cases.expected: Edits made after opening the native chooser but before file selection/change must survive an attempt to apply that older open intent.

scope: Literal fixtures and DOM observations; no production module imports. Actual Chromium chooser intercepted by Puppeteer; DOM edits while outstanding are an instrumented interval probe, not physical OS-modal user interaction. No fix source inspected.
